ModMetaData.name: Power Grid Manager
ModMetaData.author: ArliT1-F
ModMetaData.description:
Monitor colony power networks, generation, consumption, storage and history from a centralised dashboard. Power Grid Manager observes RimWorld's own power simulation and never replaces or alters it.
Open the Power tab to see map-wide totals, per-network detail, a searchable table of every powered building, recorded charts of generation, consumption, net balance, battery charge and load, evidence-based diagnostics and a labelled battery endurance estimate. All figures are marked as measured, configured or estimated.
An optional, disabled-by-default Management tab adds compatible on/off controls, monitoring groups, per-building exclusions, user-set priorities, a load-shedding policy with hysteresis and an action history. Monitoring works without it, and only buildings you explicitly mark may be switched off automatically. No DLC, Harmony or other mod required.
